slices.title: Resolve self-falsification cycle findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the finding fixes for this epic, I want to patch the CI functional outage, test assertions, and agent records, so that the self-falsification cycle findings are resolved and the pipeline passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the EmployeeDossierControllerTest is run, When endpoints are accessed, Then they return 200/201 instead of 401.
Given the AuthControllerTest, When testLtiLaunch_JsonPayload_Success is executed, Then it asserts secure Set-Cookie delivery instead of URL redirect tokens.
Given the agent task records, When reviewed, Then PR 1600 uses a binary verdict and PR 1597 includes a DOD mentioning error states.
